question: What is myscape?
answer: myscape is made up of two parts: a RuneLite plugin that syncs your in-game data to this website. This linking allows for the use of a suite of apps within myscape, such as a loot tracker with extended functionality, a way to view and search through all of your in-game possessions, a fully-functional mindmap creation app, and much more! All of these apps also offer the creation of shareable links to show others, whether or not they use myscape themselves.

question: How often does the plugin sync my data to the site?
answer: The plugin automatically sends data when something in your game changes, usually within a couple of seconds. This includes xp drops, getting loot from an NPC, changing the contents of your bank/inventory, and much more. The main exception to this is the collection log; the data is still sent immediately when a new clog is received, but an initial opening of the collection log must happen for its contents to back-sync for the first time.
